description: Bus arrival and departure time updates in the Greater Sydney Area is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Tingsen (Tim) Xian et al. Public Transport Authorities generate large quantities of data as part of their daily operations, including vehicle positions, arrival times, and dynamic routing options. This information is essential feedback into the system for planning routes and timetables, modelling passenger demand growth and evaluating operational performance. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: CSV, TXT, Image, GTFS. The data are held in the data repository named in the paper and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
